Change nothing else and do not reformat the file.' --model haiku --permission-mode acceptEdits
claude.observed: Every Edit was allowed and arrived with a PreToolUse system-reminder carrying the injected 'Codebase map, before you write:' block; editing scripts/hooks/agent_hook.py returned its own symbols, naming command (Method) at scripts/hooks/agent_hook.py:199, file_query at :467 and map_query_hint at :490, and closing with 'Check these before changing shared behaviour. Nothing is blocked.' No edit was denied. The discard guard holds at this version: 'cd <repo> && git restore src/owner.py' against a dirty file is refused with 'Blocked git restore: it would discard uncommitted work in src/owner.py', the file still reads value = 99, and git stash push then git stash pop both stayed allowed and round-tripped the same line. Layer 2's revert behaviour on this runtime is proven by agent-hook-contract-check.py driving the same binary in Claude's dialect, not by a destructive live run in a real repository. The end-of-turn lane is proven live at this version: the agent changed only VALUE, and the file came back as 'export const spacing = 1;' / 'export const VALUE = 2;' — the untouched line was reformatted after the turn ended, so biome ran from the Stop hook rather than from the model. The lane fixture needs its own minimal biome.json; copying this repository's biome.json into it makes biome check 0 files and the lane proves nothing.

Do not use shell commands to edit. Change nothing else.' — run with and without the flag to see the trust gate
codex.observed: Session 019fec7b-4dc8-7dd0-a418-480782427dac applied TAX = 0.25 and quoted the injected 'Codebase map, before you write:' text back, so Codex still hands PreToolUse additionalContext to the model rather than discarding it. Nothing was denied. Layer 2 is proven in that same session: the shell append to src/billing.py ran unblocked, PostToolUse reverted it and kept the discarded bytes under ~/.cache/hard-eng/agent-hooks/rescued/019fec7b-...-1786379129/src/billing.py, and after the map query cleared src/billing.py and src/pricing.py the next writes stayed, leaving MARKER = 1 in place. The end-of-turn lane is proven at this version only with the trust bypass: with --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust the untouched line came back as 'export const spacing = 1;' and the session state lost its edits entry, so format_lane ran from Stop. Without the flag the same lane twice left 'export const  spacing   =   1' unformatted and left edits sitting in the session state, because ~/.codex/config.toml holds trusted_hash entries for this hooks.json under pre_tool_use:0:0 and post_tool_use:0:0 but none for stop:0:0, so Codex skips the Stop entry while still printing 'hook: Stop'. Only an interactive session can grant that trust ("Hooks need review" → "Trust all and continue"), and rewriting ~/.codex/hooks.json invalidates it again, so every setup run needs it re-granted. The Stop payload shape is unchanged: {"session_id","turn_id","transcript_path","cwd","hook_event_name":"Stop","model","permission_mode","stop_hook_active","last_assistant_message"}, still with no list of edited files. A -c hooks.Stop=[...] override adds a hook rather than replacing the configured one; both ran.
